Shares acquired from the Dividend Reinvestment Plan

Pursuant to Guardian Pharmacy Services, Inc.'s (the "Issuer") Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation, the Reporting Person's shares of Class B common stock automatically converted into shares of the Issuer's Class A common stock, on a one-for-one basis, on September 27, 2026. || Reflects the forfeiture of 19,337 unvested restricted stock units by the Reporting Person in connection with his retirement from the Company. The Reporting Person also forfeited 50,000 unvested stock options in connection with his retirement from the Company.
